provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Eldermere is centered at 40.832585, 123.461399 under Cooperative Commonwealth, with 182,371,000 people across 10 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Eldermere occupies  sq mi /  sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory. Its province terrain is led by Mountain range, Deep cavern, Partial forest. Faelmere and Oakenshire carry the mountain record: Faelmere is a hybrid settlement partly perched on a mountain side, and Oakenshire descends through caverns with underworld rumors.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Dwarven and Gnomish Kin, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Harengon, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin, Centaur, Giff, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Freeblade Veil, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Thalunesh, Iskareth, Asethyr, Sigrananna, Bastveig, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 10 recorded four-province geography group links, including 9 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.
mountainSettlementNotes: Faelmere: Faelmere is a hybrid town partly perched on a mountain side.
